title: 移动平均与环比
learningObjective: 计算连续月份的移动平均及销售环比，处理不足窗口和无定义比率。
concept: 移动平均平滑短期波动；环比比较本期与上一自然期的变化率。三行窗口只有在每月一行且日期连续时才代表三个月。首两月可按已有行计算，也可按严格完整窗口口径返回空值，必须明确。
syntax: AVG(v) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)

columns.name: month
columns.mysqlType: VARCHAR(160) CHARACTER SET utf8mb4 COLLATE utf8mb4_0900_bin

mysqlSql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT month,ROUND(moving_avg,2) AS avg3,ROUND(100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY month;
sqliteSql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT month,ROUND(moving_avg,2) AS avg3,ROUND(100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0),2) AS growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY month;
executionSteps: 取得上期销售与移动平均
useCase: 月度销售报表按连续月份统计，移动平均允许不足三个月取已有记录，环比为百分数，首月和零分母不计算。
comparison: 移动平均描述平滑水平，不是增长率。

commonError.example: 把本期当分母，或将首期环比填成0。
commonError.correction: 使用上期非零值为分母；无上期保留空值。

notes: 月份缺失先补时间轴；未知销售不能自动当作零。

compatibility.detail: 仅在本示例数据与语义范围验证；不代表全部 MySQL 语法兼容。

steps.label: 按月计算前三行窗口均值

teaching.problem: 月度销售报表按连续月份统计，移动平均允许不足三个月取已有记录，环比为百分数，首月和零分母不计算。
teaching.codeExplanation: 内层公用表表达式同时计算 LAG 和 AVG。外层使用 100.0*(sales-prev)/NULLIF(prev,0)；先减后除，分母为上期，最后舍入。严格三月口径还需要检查窗口内有效值数。
teaching.resultExplanation: 二月均值1250，环比50%；三月均值1333.33，环比0%；四月均值1300，环比-40%。首月环比未知。

checkpoints.name: m
checkpoints.label: 逐月补充上期销售与移动平均
checkpoints.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT month,sales,LAG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month) AS prev,AVG(sales) OVER(ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg FROM monthly) SELECT * FROM m ORDER BY month;

mergeExamples.label: 严格完整窗口
mergeExamples.explanation: 仅在三个有效月均存在时给出平均。
mergeExamples.sql: SELECT month,CASE WHEN COUNT(sales) OVER w=3 THEN ROUND(AVG(sales) OVER w,2) END AS full_avg FROM monthly WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) ORDER BY month;

mergeExamples.label: 零分母
mergeExamples.explanation: 上期为零时，即使本期为正也不能计算普通环比。
